4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS

  6A. PROCLAMATION declaring May 7, 2024 as National Teacher Day in the City of
  Torrance.
  6A - STAFF REPORT

  6B. PROCLAMATION declaring May 11, 2024 as Fire Service Day in the City of
  Torrance.
  6B - STAFF REPORT

  6C. PROCLAMATION declaring May 5-11, 2024 as Public Service Recognition Week
  in the City of Torrance.
  6C - STAFF REPORT

  6D. PROCLAMATION declaring May 2024 as Asian American and Pacific Islander
  Heritage Month in the City of Torrance.
   6D - STAFF REPORT

  6E.  PROCLAMATION declaring May 2024 as National Preservation Month in the City
  of Torrance.
  6E- STAFF REPORT

  6F.  PROCLAMATION declaring May 2024 as Older Americans Month in the City of
  Torrance.
  6F -STAFF REPORT

  6G. Commission on Aging and Community Services – Recognize 2024 Older
  Americans Award Recipients. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Commission on Aging and Community Services Director that City
  Council recognize Carolyn Pohlner, Celina Henderson, Dan Delfoss, Laurie Love and
  Pamela Popovich as the 2024 Older Americans Award recipients.

  6H. Recognition of the Bishop Montgomery High School Girl’s Basketball Team.

  6I.  RESOLUTION NO. 2024-20 declaring May 17 through May 19, 2024 for
  Observance of the 62nd Annual Armed Forces Day Parade and Celebration. (For
  Presentation)
  6I - STAFF REPORT
  6I - MATERIALS AVAILABLE

  6J.  RESOLUTION NO. 2024-21 expressing appreciation to Colonel Michael S.
  Hopkins for serving as the Honorary Grand Marshal of the 62nd Annual Armed
  Forces Day Parade and Observance. (For Presentation)
  6J - STAFF REPORT
  6J - MATERIALS AVAILABLE

  6K. RESOLUTION NO. 2024-22 expressing appreciation to Lieutenant General Philip
  A. Garrant of the United States Space Force for serving as Grand Marshal of the
  62nd Annual Armed Forces Day Parade and Observance. (For Presentation)
  6K - STAFF REPORT
  6K - MATERIALS AVAILABLE

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items under the Consent Calendar or items that
  are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on
  items raised during public comment, but may respond briefly to statements made or
  questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals
  are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no
  longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If
  presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk
  before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
  PUBLIC COMMENT
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT RECIEVED AFTER 5:30 P.M. ON 5/06/24 AND PRIOR TO
  ADJOURMENT AT 2:20 A.M. ON 5/08/24

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..

  8A. City Clerk – Approve City Council Minutes. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council approve the City Council minutes of
  April 9, 2024.

9.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  9A. City Manager and Community Development – Accept and Appropriate Grant
  Allocation from State of California for Community Resource and Response
  Center Rehabilitation. Expenditure: None.
   Recommendation of the City Manager and Community Development Director that City
  Council accept and appropriate a grant funding allocation from the State of California to a
  newly created Grant Project in the amount of $5,500,000 for the rehabilitation of the
  Community Resource and Response Center located at 2300 Carson Street.
  9A - STAFF REPORT

  9B. Employee Relations and Public Safety Committee – Receive Announcement of
  Torrance Fire Department Reaccreditation and Accept and File Committee
  Meeting Reports and Minutes from March 7, 2024. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the Employee Relations and Public Safety Committee that City
  Council:
  1) Receive announcement of achieved reaccreditation of the Torrance Fire Department by
  the Commission on Fire Accreditation International; and
  2) Accept and file the Torrance Fire Department’s Community Risk Assessment/Standards
  of Cover for 2023; and
  3) Accept and file the Torrance Fire Department’s Annual Quality Improvement Update
  Report for 2023; and
  4) Accept and file the Torrance Fire Department’s SB1205 Compliance Report for 2023;
  and
  5) Accept and file the Committee meeting minutes from March 7, 2024.
  9B - STAFF REPORT

  9C. City Council - Adopt RESOLUTION Approving and Formally Recognizing the
  Month of June as Pride Month. Expenditure: None.
  In response to an oral request by Councilmember Sharon Kalani with City Council
  concurrence, it is the recommendation of the City Council that City Council adopt a
  RESOLUTION approving and formally recognizing the month of June as Pride Month to
  honor all members of the LGBTQIA+ community.
  9C - STAFF REPORT
  9C - SUPPLEMENTAL
  LATE PUBLIC COMMENT

  9D. Police – Approve Second Amendment to Master Services and Purchasing
  Agreement for Body-Worn and In-Car Cameras with Integrated Cloud-Based
  Solutions. Expenditure: $10,649,140.21 (General Fund).
  Recommendation of the Chief of Police that City Council approve a second amendment to
  the master services and purchasing agreement with Axon Enterprise, Inc. of Scottsdale, AZ
  (C2022-184) in the amount of $10,649,140.21 to provide body-worn and in-car cameras
  with integrated cloud-based solutions for a 10-year period beginning May 7, 2024 and
  ending May 6, 2034.
  9D - STAFF REPORT
  9D - STAFF PRESENTATION
  9D - SUPPLEMENTAL

  9E.  City Council - Discuss and Determine Action Regarding Airport Commission.
  Expenditure: None.
  In response to an oral request by Councilmember Aurelio Mattucci with concurrence of the
  City Council, it is the recommendation of the City Council that City Council discuss and
  determine direction regarding the Airport Commission acting on an item not on the agenda.
  9E - STAFF REPORT
  9E - SUPPLEMENTAL
  9E - LATE PUBLIC COMMENT

RECESS

RECONVENE

RECESS

RECONVENE

9D. Police – Approve Second Amendment to Master Services and Purchasing Agreement
  for Body-Worn and In-Car Cameras with Integrated Cloud-Based Solutions.
   Expenditure: $10,649,140.21 (General Fund).

10.  HEARINGS

  10A. City Manager and Finance – Conduct First Public Hearing on Proposed Fiscal
  Year 2024-25 Operating Budget and Capital Improvement Plan. Expenditure:
  None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager and Finance Director that City Council conduct the
  first public hearing on the Proposed Fiscal Year 2024-25 Operating Budget and Capital
  Improvement Plan.
  10A - STAFF REPORT
  10A - STAFF PRESENTATION
  10A - MATERIALS AVAILABLE
  10A - SUPPLEMENTAL

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled.

12.  2ND READING ORDINANCES – None Scheduled.

13.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) Council Order - Kaji,
  Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, Gerson, and Mayor Chen This portion of the meeting
  is reserved for comments on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act,
  City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may respond
  briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item
  to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral
  Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts when you
  step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide
  11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you
  speak.

RECESSED TO CLOSED SESSION - Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 (d)(1)

RECONVENE

15.  ADJOURNMENT

  15A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, May 21, 2024, at 5:00 p.m. for
  closed session, with regular business commencing at 6:30 p.m. in the Leroy J.
  Jackson Council Chamber. Tuesday, May 14, 2024, is a Council Dark Night.
  15A - STAFF REPORT
